Before we go any further, we need to clear things up. Is it "A SJW" or "An SJW"?

An.

When dealing with acronyms you look to the sound at the beginning of the acronym to determine which you use.

NDA -> En Dee Aye -> An NDA

BA -> Bee Aye -> A BA

It's completely dependent on context: If you say "Ess-Jay-DoubleYew" it's "an" if you say "Social Justice Warrior", it's "a"... basic grammar.

I think a better question would be: Can SJW be plural or does it require the additional "s"?

Technically you can do three things with acronyms.

Pluralize, leave it alone, or pluralize using an apostrophe.

WMDs/W.M.D.s

WMD/W.M.D.

WMD's/W.M.D.'s

Generally you do the third, but all three are accepted by modern English.
